# Kubernetes Clusters Capacity Report

This report provides an overview of the capacity and current utilization of all Kubernetes clusters in the environment.

## Cluster Summary

| Cluster | Platform | K8s Version | Total Nodes | Ready Nodes | Total Pods | Running Pods | Pending Pods | Failed Pods | Total Deployments | Available Deployments | Total Namespaces | Warning Events |
|---------|----------|-------------|------------|------------|-----------|--------------|--------------|------------|-------------------|-----------------------|------------------|----------------|

| prod-west | GKE | v1.29.6 | 9 | 9 | {{int:99:149}} | {{int:68:102}} | 4 | 0 | {{int:49:75}} | {{int:31:47}} | {{int:18:28}} | {{int:23:35}} |
| staging | kubeadm | v1.31.1 | 6 | 5 | {{int:252:380}} | {{int:148:224}} | 4 | 1 | {{int:16:26}} | {{int:39:59}} | 7 | 9 |

## Observations

- **Node Utilization**: `prod-east` has many nodes but relatively low readiness (4/10 ready). `prod-west` has all nodes ready. `staging` has most nodes ready.
- **Pod Status**: `prod-east` shows more running pods than total pods, indicating a possible data inconsistency; please verify the source metrics. `prod-west` and `staging` have pending pods (4 each).
- **Deployment Availability**: All clusters have a healthy number of available deployments compared to total deployments.
- **Warning Events**: `prod-west` has the highest number of warning events ({{int:23:35}}), which may warrant investigation.

## Recommendations

1. Investigate why `prod-east` has only 4 ready nodes out of {{int:8:12}} and why running pods exceed total pods.
2. Review warning events in `prod-west` to identify recurring issues.
3. Monitor pending pods in `prod-west` and `staging` to ensure they transition to running state promptly.
